**Finding: Compliant** (Section 19, ¶¶ 19.1–19.5) — no redline proposed.

Section 19 sits at (indeed slightly above) the preferred position:

- **Standard of performance** — 19.1: professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation/specifications.
- **Duration** — 19.2: 90 days after delivery *or acceptance, whichever is later* for Deliverables; Hosted Services conform *throughout the subscription term*, which is better than the preferred 12-month software period for the subscription element.
- **Other warranties** — 19.3: no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, no contaminating open-source use.
- **Remedy** — 19.4: prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Disclaimer** — 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly preserves express warranties, service levels, indemnities and stated remedies, so it does not swallow the express warranty.
